description: Estimate the total cost of a programme for a given family: investment + government & due-diligence fees + family add-ons. Indicative; excludes professional/property/legal fees.

children_16plus.description: Number of dependent children aged 16 or over — usually priced higher than under-16s.

children_under16.description: Number of dependent children aged under 16 — priced separately by most Caribbean programmes.

programme_id.description: Programme id as returned by list_programmes (e.g. "st-kitts-cbi") or an unambiguous name ("St Kitts"); an ambiguous name returns the candidates.

name: estimate_total_cost

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.
